title: In situ bulk hydrogen intercalation in a mirror-symmetric Ru/WO3−x nanoarray boosts neutral electrocatalytic nitrate reduction to ammonia
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03970J, Paper
Hongchuan Fu, Song Lu, Yu Xin, Shoukang Xiao, Liyu Chen, Yingwei Li, Kui Shen
An unprecedented mirror-symmetric Ru/MSN-WO3−x nanoarray is successfully constructed. The hydrogen intercalation endows Ru/MSN-HyWO3−x with a dynamic proton-concentrated microenvironment, which accelerates the hydrogenation of nitrate to ammonia.
